INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

videos.caption: Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Rice Bake A delicious one-pan dinner featuring juicy chicken coated in a sweet, sticky honey garlic glaze, baked over fluffy seasoned rice with carrots and topped with green onions. 55–65 minutes Ingredients For the chicken: 1½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp olive oil For the honey garlic sauce: ⅓ cup honey ¼ cup soy sauce 4 garlic cloves, minced 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp grated ginger 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water For the rice: 1½ cups uncooked long-grain white rice 2¼ cups chicken broth 1 medium carrot, diced ½ cup chopped onion 1 tbsp butter ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 2 green onions, chopped (garnish) Instructions 1. Preheat oven: Set your oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken: Toss chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and olive oil. 3. Prepare rice: Spread uncooked rice in a greased baking dish. Add carrots, onions, butter, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir together. 4. Prepare sauce: In a saucepan, combine honey, soy sauce, garlic, ketchup, vinegar, and ginger. Simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until slightly thickened. 5. Assemble: Place seasoned chicken over the rice and brush generously with honey garlic sauce, reserving some sauce for serving. 6. Bake: Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35–40 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 7. Finish: Brush with reserved sauce (reheat it first if it touched raw chicken). Broil for 2–3 minutes until golden and sticky, watching carefully. 8. Serve: Sprinkle with chopped green onions and serve hot. Tip: If the rice needs more time, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking. For a glossy restaurant-style finish, brush the chicken with extra honey garlic glaze just before serving. This is a homemade version inspired by the dish shown, rather than the creator's confirmed recipe. Similar chicken-and-rice bakes use a covered-then-uncovered baking method.  #HoneyGarlicChicken ##HoneyGarlicChickeny#ChickenAndRice#EasyDinnerRecipesghts ##foodseasytomake

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Stop 🛑 everything and make this easy weeknight dinner! Teriyaki chicken, peanut chili noodles and a crunchy cucumber salad. So little effort, and everyone, big and small, will devour it! I love my sheet pan with the elevated wire rack! Which can be found in my Amazon storefront there is a direct link in my bio✨ CHICKEN 6 boneless chicken pieces, about 2½ lb (I used 4 thighs + 2 breasts) 1 cup teriyaki sauce (I love Soyaki), plus extra for basting NOODLES 10 oz mafaldine number 16 pasta ⅓ cup smooth peanut butter 2 tbsp grated ginger 2 tbsp minced garlic 2 tbsp rice vinegar 2 tbsp honey 2–3 tbsp chili paste ⅓ cup soy sauce 4 cups water 1 cup finely chopped green onions (about 4) 1 cup julienned carrot (about 1) CUCUMBER SALAD 6 Persian cucumbers, thinly sliced diagonally 4 green onions, finely chopped ½ bunch fresh mint, finely chopped ⅓ cup seasoned rice vinegar (orange cap; a little sweeter than regular rice vinegar. If using regular, add 1 tbsp brown sugar) 2 tbsp chili crunch (recipe pinned in comments)  TO FINISH Chopped green onions + toasted sesame seeds 1. Toss chicken with teriyaki sauce. For extra flavor, marinate in the refrigerator for 2–4 hours. 2. Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C). In the sheet pan, whisk peanut butter, ginger, garlic, vinegar, honey, chili paste, soy sauce and water. Stir in green onions and carrot. Add pasta, pressing it into the liquid as much as possible. 3. Set the elevated rack over the pan and arrange chicken on top. Bake 25 minutes. Baste with extra teriyaki sauce kept separate from the raw chicken, then bake about 20 minutes more, until chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and noodles are tender. The noodles must also reach 165°F (74°C), since chicken juices drip onto them. If desired, broil up to 5 minutes, watching closely. 4. Meanwhile, toss all cucumber salad ingredients together. 5. Remove rack and toss noodles in the sauce. Slice chicken, serve with noodles and salad, and finish with green onions and toasted sesame seeds. If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. My Creamy Chicken & Leek pie is just what you need on a cold day✨🥧🍂  Here’s The Full Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients 600g chicken breast, diced 1 tbsp olive oil 1 leek, finely chopped 1 onion, diced 200g chestnut mushrooms, sliced 3 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 500ml chicken stock  100g cream cheese 50g smoked Applewood cheese, grated 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp dried oregano Salt and black pepper, to taste 1 sheet ready-rolled puff pastry 1 egg, beaten (for the egg wash) Instructions 1. Season the chicken: Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with paprika, dried oregano, salt and black pepper. Mix well to coat evenly. 2. Brown the chicken: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and fry until golden on the outside. It doesn’t need to be fully cooked through at this stage. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables: In the same pan, add the chopped leek, diced onion and sliced chestnut mushrooms. Sauté for around 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the crushed garlic and cook for another minute. 4. Make the sauce: Stir in the Dijon mustard, then pour in the chicken stock. Mix well, scraping up any flavourful bits from the bottom of the pan. 5. Simmer the filling: Return the chicken to the pan and simmer gently for around 10–15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has reduced slightly. 6. Add the cheese: Stir in the cream cheese until smooth, then add the grated smoked Applewood cheese. Mix until melted and creamy. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Allow the filling to cool before assembling the pie. 7. Assemble the pie: Preheat the oven to 200°C conventional / 180°C fan / Gas Mark 6. Transfer the cooled filling to an ovenproof pie dish. Lay the puff pastry over the top, trim any excess and press the edges down to seal. Cut a small slit in the centre to allow steam to escape. 8. Egg wash and bake: Brush the pastry with beaten egg and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until the pastry is puffed up and beautifully golden. 9. Serve: Allow the pie to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Enjoy with buttery mash, your favourite greens & plenty of hot gravy!  #easyrecipes #cookwithme #dinnerideas #cozyseason #mealinspo

The lightly sweet, savory flavor was a hit with both the kids and adults 👍🏻 If you follow the recipe below, you’ll get perfectly balanced Honey Garlic Chicken that’s not too salty or too sweet. Give it a try! 🤍 📝 Honey Garlic Chicken 1. Pat the chicken thighs(about 2lbs) dry with paper towels. Season with 1 tbsp salt, a few cracks of black pepper, 2 tbsp cornstarch, and 2 tbsp sweet rice flour. 2. Heat some olive oil and ½ tbsp butter in a pan. Place the chicken thighs in skin-side down and cook until golden and crispy. Cook over medium-low heat so the chicken cooks all the way through without burning the outside. 3. Once the chicken is fully cooked, set it aside. In the same pan, lightly sauté 2 tbsp minced garlic with 1 tbsp butter. Then add 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1½ tbsp vinegar, 2 tbsp water, and 3½ tbsp honey to make the sauce. 4. Add the cooked chicken back to the pan and quickly toss everything together until the sauce coats the chicken. ❤️ It’s so simple but SO delicious, I’m sure this will become one of those recipes you’ll want to make again and again! 😍 #치킨  #허니갈릭치킨  #honeygarlicchicken  #chickenthigh  #kidsdinner
